title: Concept: Cluster namespace disclosed
description: A namespace field naming the deployment environment in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The namespace tells the attacker whether the response came from staging or production, which is the difference between probing safely and causing damage.
applicability: Deployments that render a namespace field naming the deployment environment into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The namespace tells the attacker whether the response came from staging or production, which is the difference between probing safely and causing damage.
